articles.title: TSMC reports strong 2nm yield ramp ahead of 2027 volume production
articles.summary: TSMC signaled its N2 node is tracking ahead of prior yield curves, with risk production expanding across Fab 20 in Hsinchu.

articles.title: Nvidia unveils next-gen Rubin architecture roadmap details
articles.summary: Nvidia outlined packaging and memory bandwidth targets for its post-Blackwell Rubin platform, aimed at 2027 data center deployment.

articles.title: ASML High-NA EUV tool shipments accelerate into second half
articles.summary: ASML confirmed additional High-NA EUV units shipped to logic customers, a key enabler for sub-2nm patterning.

articles.title: US Commerce Department updates export control list for advanced packaging tools
articles.summary: New guidance narrows which advanced packaging and deposition tools can be shipped to certain markets without a license.

articles.title: Samsung Foundry courts new customers with 2nm GAA process pitch
articles.summary: Samsung is positioning its gate-all-around 2nm node as a differentiator to win back foundry customers from TSMC.

articles.title: Intel Foundry secures external customer commitment for 18A capacity
articles.summary: Intel Foundry announced a multi-year capacity agreement, a milestone in its push to become a credible external foundry.

articles.title: AMD expands chiplet strategy with new interposer packaging partner
articles.summary: AMD's next MI-series accelerators will use a new interposer supplier to diversify advanced packaging capacity.

articles.title: Synopsys and Cadence both report AI-driven EDA revenue growth
articles.summary: Both major EDA vendors cited AI-assisted verification and place-and-route tools as a growing share of licensing revenue.

articles.title: SK Hynix HBM4 samples ship to key AI accelerator customers
articles.summary: SK Hynix began sampling next-generation HBM4 memory stacks, targeting qualification for 2027 AI accelerator platforms.

articles.title: Qualcomm expands automotive chip design wins with two new OEMs
articles.summary: Qualcomm's Snapdragon Digital Chassis platform picked up new automaker design wins for ADAS and infotainment.

articles.title: Applied Materials sees deposition equipment demand tied to gate-all-around transition
articles.summary: Demand for atomic-layer deposition tools is rising as foundries transition from FinFET to gate-all-around transistors.

articles.title: SMIC reportedly making incremental gains on mature-node yields amid equipment constraints
articles.summary: Industry analysts note steady but constrained progress at SMIC's mature nodes given continued equipment export limits.

articles.title: Arm reports record licensing quarter on strength of compute subsystems
articles.summary: Arm's pre-built compute subsystem offering continues to gain traction with data center and mobile customers alike.

articles.title: Micron raises capex guidance on HBM and DDR5 demand
articles.summary: Micron increased its fiscal-year capital expenditure outlook, citing sustained AI-driven memory demand.

articles.title: Analog Devices completes acquisition of niche RF component maker
articles.summary: The deal adds specialized RF front-end IP to ADI's portfolio, aimed at defense and telecom customers.

articles.title: TSMC Arizona fab reaches volume production milestone for 4nm
articles.summary: TSMC's first US fab reached commercial volume production, part of a broader push to diversify manufacturing geography.

articles.title: Nvidia and TSMC deepen CoWoS advanced packaging capacity agreement
articles.summary: The expanded agreement addresses a persistent bottleneck in CoWoS packaging capacity for AI accelerators.

articles.title: EU Chips Act second phase funding allocated to pilot lines
articles.summary: The European Commission allocated additional funding to pilot production lines for next-generation chip packaging.

articles.title: Cadence launches new AI-assisted verification platform
articles.summary: The new platform aims to cut verification cycle times for large SoC designs using generative AI assistance.

articles.title: Texas Instruments expands 300mm analog fab capacity in Texas
articles.summary: TI's new 300mm facility is aimed at expanding domestic analog and power chip capacity over the next several years.
